craft_notes: Sthāyin: svādhyāya-vīra of study-and-making — hermetic couplets, hyphen-pressure; music in pack + terminal words; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (owner verdict required). Spandayor dual kept per UNC; speaker-spoken-self triple; sixfold road close. Rejected: (a) singular throb → killed by UNC. (b) road→path → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: THERE — SPEAK-er, SPOK-en, SELF … SE-quen-ces' SIX-fold-ROAD.

lines: There — speaker, spoken, self — of two throbs singly —
Lord's gross, fine, supreme shine — sequences' sixfold road.
